profile.name: PANKIL
profile.headline: Experienced Pastry Chef | Baker | Lead Chef

summary: Accomplished pastry chef with 4 years of experience in high-volume artisan bakeries. Expert in French pastry techniques, complete bakery operations, and team leadership. Proven success in production planning, inventory optimization, and bulk order management.

bullets: Produce full range of French pastries from scratch: **cakes, kouign-amann, tarts, croissants, Danish, and specialty desserts**.
Develop and refine recipes based on seasonal ingredients and customer feedback.
Coordinate bulk orders and custom requests, meeting deadlines while maintaining excellence.
Oversee inventory: conduct stock assessments, forecast needs, and order supplies to minimize waste.
Created laminated pastries daily: **croissants, pain au chocolat, pain aux raisins, turnovers**.
Produced **tarts, shortcakes, scones, cookies, and cream-filled pastries**.
Coordinate team scheduling and lead operations in the absence of the head chef, ensuring smooth workflow and team performance.
Maintain product consistency and high standards in presentation, flavor, and quality.
Produced a wide variety of breads, rolls, and pastries for early morning retail sales.
Tracked inventory, rotated stock, and placed supply orders.
Assisted with inventory management and placed supply orders as needed.
Maintained a clean, organized, and compliant work environment.
Prepared fresh batches of baked goods including bagels, muffins, cookies, and pastries.
Operated and cleaned commercial baking equipment.
Rotated stock and minimized food waste through proper inventory management.
Implemented stock rotation and minimized food waste.

items: Advanced Pastry & Baking Techniques: Expert in producing laminated and enriched doughs, pastries, tarts, scones, cookies, and cakes from scratch using traditional and modern methods.
Production & Inventory Management: Responsible for planning daily and weekly production based on business needs; adjust output for busy and slow days to minimize waste and meet demand.
Team Leadership & Scheduling: Step into managerial duties including staff scheduling, supervising team workflow, and ensuring operations run smoothly in the head chef's absence.
Teamwork & Training: Experienced in collaborating with team members and mentoring new staff on food preparation, cooking, and safety standards.
Customer Satisfaction: Dedicated to delivering consistent, high-quality products that meet customer and business expectations.

projects.name: Operational Efficiency & Cost Management
bullets: Reduced waste by 30% through efficient inventory management and stock rotation strategies.

projects.name: Production & Quality Excellence
bullets: Baked 200+ Items daily, enhancing visual appeal and sales.
